programme.notes: Programme page as recorded in kb_imported_dev.json (not re-researched in this top-up).

value.value: minimum average of 65% (Senior High School Certificate)
value.description: International column of the programme's entry requirements: SHSC pass with minimum average 65%, at least 60%/B- in Mathematics and in one of Physics, Computing, Chemistry, Biology. Same column: Matriculation/Foundation minimum CGPA 3.00.

gpa.quote: Senior High School Certificate (SHSC) Pass with a minimum average of 65% Obtain a minimum of 60% / grade B- in Mathematics subjects.
gpa.notes: Bachelor of Computer Science (Software Engineering) - the programme recorded in the KB. The page lists Local and International requirement columns; this row is in the International column (the local rows say 'Malaysian citizen'). Meeting the minimum does not guarantee admission.

deadline.notes: Semester I (October) intake, Academic Session 2026/2027, international applicants (exception: MBBS 9 June 2026). Already passed on 2026-10-19; the October 2027 window is not yet published. A Semester II (March) 2026/2027 international window '07 Sept 2026 30 Jan 2027' exists, but the CS (Software Engineering) page lists 'Intake Semester 1 (October)' only.

tuition.quote: International RM 89,200 ( Note: Not inclusive of 6% Sales and Service Tax (SST))
tuition.notes: Programme page 'Tuition Fee' block; same figure in the international fee structure PDF (https://study.um.edu.my/doc/tution-fee/Fee%20Structure%2C%20UG%2C%20International%20-%20Updated%2022%20Oct%202025.pdf?_t=1761184801, 'Academic session 2025/2026 TUITION FEE (RM) (INTERNATIONAL)', 'Bachelor of Computer Science (Software Engineering) 89,200.00'). UM lists the fee for the whole programme (e.g. MBBS 673,200), not per year - period recorded as programme total; not divided. SST 6% extra.

scholarship_exists.notes: https://aasd.um.edu.my/financial-aid-for-undergraduate lists external schemes (PTPTN loan, PMG pharmacy scholarship, etc.) aimed at Malaysian students; no UM scholarship for international CS undergraduates found.
